results.title: PDF viewer broken due to .json/.ftl rewrite rules
results.detail: locale.json and viewer.ftl return 200 (304 cached) via Chrome; without json|ftl exclusion they 404 through index.php (X-Powered-By PHP). Setup.php RewriteCond updated.

results.title: System tag multibyte name >64 bytes → 500
results.detail: POST /remote.php/dav/systemtags with 63 ASCII + Cyrillic returns 201; stored name is 63 ASCII chars (mb_strcut). Unit tests testCreateOverlong* OK (2 tests).
